result.instructions: Tools for FiscalHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What NCM code applies to a portable laptop, and what taxes apply?"; "Simulate the totals of a sale of 2 items to Rio de Janeiro before I issue the NF-e."; "Get the authorized XML for this NF-e access key.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FiscalHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fiscalhub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fiscalhub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fiscalhub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fiscalhub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fiscalhub_get_nfe_xml
tools.title: Get an NF-e XML
tools.description: Get the authorized NF-e XML (nfe-proc: NF-e plus protocol) for an access key, fetched from the SEFAZ. Use it to recover an XML that was not stored locally. FiscalHub: GET /api/v1/nfe/{chave}/xml.

chave.description: Access key (chave de acesso) of the document: 44 digits.

tools.name: fiscalhub_list_received_nfe
tools.title: List received NF-e (DFe)
tools.description: List NF-es and events issued against a company's CNPJ, fetched from the SEFAZ (Distribuicao DFe), in NSU order. Pass the returned ultNsu next time to get only new documents. Each document has its schema (resNFe, nfeProc or procEventoNFe). FiscalHub: GET /api/v1/nfe/distribuicao.

empresaId.description: FiscalHub company id (empresaId) that issues or receives the document.

ultNsu.description: Last NSU you received. Use 0 (default) to start from the beginning.

chNFe.description: Optional: fetch one NF-e by its access key.

tools.name: fiscalhub_get_ncm
tools.title: Get an NCM code
tools.description: Get the tax data of one exact NCM product code: description, IPI rate, CEST and unit of measure. FiscalHub: GET /api/v1/ncm/{codigo}.

tools.name: fiscalhub_search_ncm
tools.title: Search NCM codes
tools.description: Search NCM product codes by a partial code or a description term. Use it to find the NCM for a product before issuing a document. FiscalHub: GET /api/v1/ncm/buscar?q=.

q.description: Partial NCM code or a word from the product description.

tools.name: fiscalhub_simulate_nfe_totals
tools.title: Simulate NF-e totals
tools.description: Simulate the tax totals of an NF-e (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, IBS, CBS and the invoice total) before issuing it. Nothing is issued or stored. FiscalHub: POST /api/v1/tributario/simular-nfe.

empresaId.description: FiscalHub company id (empresaId) that issues or receives the document.

naturezaOperacao.description: Nature of the operation, for example "Venda".

cfop.description: CFOP operation code: 4 digits, for example 5102.

tools.name: fiscalhub_emit_nfe
tools.title: Issue an NF-e
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: issues an NF-e (model 55) and sends it to the SEFAZ for authorization. A production company issues a legal document that the customer must cancel if it is wrong. Whether it is homologation or production depends on the company's setting in FiscalHub. FiscalHub: POST /api/v1/nfe/emitir.

empresaId.description: FiscalHub company id (empresaId) that issues or receives the document.

naturezaOperacao.description: Nature of the operation, for example "Venda de mercadoria".

numeroItem.description: Item number, from 1 (default: the item's position in the list).

codigoProduto.description: Your product code, for example PROD-001.

cfop.description: CFOP operation code: 4 digits, for example 5102.

unidadeComercial.description: Unit of measure, for example UN.

valorTotal.description: Item total (default: quantidade x valorUnitario, rounded to 2 decimals).

impostos.description: Taxes for this item. For the tax reform (IBS/CBS) use the ibsCbs object from the FiscalHub docs.

tools.name: fiscalhub_cancel_nfe
tools.title: Cancel an NF-e
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: cancels an authorized NF-e by its access key, with a required justification. The tax authority records the cancellation and it cannot be undone. FiscalHub: POST /api/v1/nfe/{chave}/cancelar.

chave.description: Access key (chave de acesso) of the document: 44 digits.

justificativa.description: Reason for the cancellation, 15 to 255 characters (the tax authority requires it).

cpfCnpj.description: CPF or CNPJ of the issuer, digits only.

tools.name: fiscalhub_emit_nfce
tools.title: Issue an NFC-e
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: issues a consumer NFC-e (model 65) and sends it to the SEFAZ for authorization. It has the same fields as an NF-e; the API applies model 65. The company's environment (homologation or production) is set in FiscalHub. FiscalHub: POST /api/v1/nfce/emitir.

empresaId.description: FiscalHub company id (empresaId) that issues or receives the document.

naturezaOperacao.description: Nature of the operation, for example "Venda de mercadoria".

numeroItem.description: Item number, from 1 (default: the item's position in the list).

codigoProduto.description: Your product code, for example PROD-001.

cfop.description: CFOP operation code: 4 digits, for example 5102.

unidadeComercial.description: Unit of measure, for example UN.

valorTotal.description: Item total (default: quantidade x valorUnitario, rounded to 2 decimals).

impostos.description: Taxes for this item. For the tax reform (IBS/CBS) use the ibsCbs object from the FiscalHub docs.

tools.title: Cancel an NFC-e
